messages.subject: Graphing in Shiny
parts:
I have a data file with depth, water temp, ec, and air temp as well as date/time stamp every 15 minutes. I am using the dygraphs option and can the data to graph. The issue I am having is that all the data is being graphed simultaneously regardless of what parameters are selected. Any suggestions how to achieve this (yes I am new to this process)?

I posted my code that I am using so far below:

library(shiny)
library(dygraphs)
library(datasets)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(xts)

sp <- read.csv("sp.csv", header = TRUE)

sp$LocalDateTime = mdy_hm(sp$LocalDateTime)
x <- as.xts(sp$LocalDateTime)
y <- sp$Depth
y1 <- sp$WaterTemp
y2 <- sp$EC
y3 <- sp$AirTemp

sp.csv <- cbind(x, y, y1, y2, y3)
colnames(sp.csv) <- c("Depth", "WaterTemp", "EC", "AirTemp")

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Teen Shale Network:  Black Moshannon State Park"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel("Select variables"),
    
    selectInput("typeInput", "Select Variable type:",
                 choices = c("Depth(m)", "WaterTemp(C)", "EC", "AirTemp"),
                 multiple = TRUE)
    
  ),

    mainPanel(
      dygraphOutput("dygraph")
    )
     )
  


server <- function(input, output) {
  output$dygraph <- renderDygraph({
    dygraph(sp.csv, main = "Black Mo SP Depth") %>%
      dySeries("Depth", axis = ('y'))%>%
      dySeries("WaterTemp", axis = ('y2'))%>%
      dyLegend(width = 500)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
